company.name: UBQT
company.shortDescription: UBQT is a social networking and community platform that helps individuals and organizations coordinate real-life meetups, events.
company.description: UBQT is a social networking and community management platform focused on facilitating in-person connections and real-world meetups. The platform allows individuals, organizations, alumni groups, conferences, and professional communities to coordinate face-to-face interactions through location-based notifications, calendar syncing, travel coordination, and event management tools. UBQT provides mobile and web applications that help users discover when their contacts are nearby, traveling to the same location, or attending the same events.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile and web application that helps users coordinate and plan in-person catchups with their network based on location and availability.
productsAndServices.name: UBQT App

productsAndServices.description: A subscription-based AI-powered feature that provides personalized suggestions, reminders, and curated introductions to help users reconnect and plan catchups.
